rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for NSCLC were downloaded from the FinnGen Study, Data Freeze 12 (https://www.finngen.fi/en/access_results), and used as the outcome dataset.
rows.coder_note: The sentence writes 'FinnGen Study, Data Freeze 12', release 12 in another form (rule A); the data availability statement repeats it; the 38,519 participants, 6,446 cases and 37,874 controls are endpoint counts and equal no release N; FinnGen alone is named, not a meta-analysis with UK Biobank or MVP.
